# How many cups a day does your boba shop need?

> Free pro forma for boba, bubble tea and specialty drink shops: profit per cup, break-even cups a day with the loan, the price for your target margin, delivery-app cost, and a 60-month ramp-up with the cash reserve you need. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
